premises: Hf addition to a dual-phase RHEA forms Hf-rich precipitates at interfaces and within the B2 phase
These precipitates hinder grain boundary sliding and dislocation motion at high temperature
This increases high-temperature strength and ductility
The effect is observed at ~0.5 at% Hf in an AlCrFeNiMo-based alloy
